checks.title: PostgreSQL version is supported (>= 13)
checks.rationale: Out-of-support PostgreSQL releases no longer receive security patches.
checks.remediation: Upgrade to a vendor-supported major release; track https://www.postgresql.org/support/versioning/.

checks.title: SSL is enabled on the cluster
checks.rationale: Encrypted in-transit connections prevent credential and data interception.
checks.remediation: Set ssl = on in postgresql.conf; provide server.crt and server.key.

checks.title: Password encryption uses scram-sha-256
checks.rationale: MD5 hashes are reversible; scram-sha-256 is the modern channel-binding default.
checks.remediation: Set password_encryption = 'scram-sha-256' and rotate user passwords.

checks.title: Connections are logged
checks.rationale: Connection logs support forensic investigation and authentication monitoring.
checks.remediation: Set log_connections = on; restart or pg_reload_conf().

checks.title: Disconnections are logged
checks.rationale: Pair with log_connections to track session lifetimes.

checks.title: Data-modifying statements are logged
checks.rationale: Logging mod statements captures the audit trail for INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE/DDL.
checks.remediation: Set log_statement = 'mod' (or 'all' for full statement audit).

checks.title: listen_addresses is not '*' (limit network exposure)
checks.rationale: Binding to '*' exposes Postgres to every network interface including potentially untrusted ones.
checks.remediation: Set listen_addresses to specific interface IPs.

checks.title: pgaudit extension is preloaded
checks.rationale: pgaudit produces detailed session and object-level audit logging required for compliance.
checks.remediation: Install pgaudit; set shared_preload_libraries = 'pgaudit' and restart.

checks.title: Manual: review pg_hba.conf for trust authentication entries
checks.audit: Inspect pg_hba.conf for any 'trust' lines. Confirm trust is only used on loopback for the postgres superuser (or removed entirely).
checks.rationale: 'trust' authentication accepts any connection without password verification.
checks.remediation: Replace 'trust' with scram-sha-256 or peer (Unix socket only).

checks.title: Manual: review database role privileges and per-role password expiry
checks.audit: Query 'SELECT rolname, rolsuper, rolvaliduntil FROM pg_roles WHERE rolcanlogin;'. Confirm superusers are limited and password expiry is set for application roles.
checks.rationale: Per-role least-privilege limits blast radius of credential compromise.
checks.remediation: ALTER ROLE <name> VALID UNTIL '<date>'; REVOKE SUPERUSER FROM application roles.
